name: Theranos
what_failed: Claimed revolutionary blood testing from a single drop. Technology never worked as advertised.
why_it_failed: Physics: insufficient blood volume for claimed test range
Fraud: used conventional machines while claiming proprietary tech
assumptions_that_broke: Miniaturization can overcome fundamental physics constraints
Secrecy is compatible with scientific validation
Charisma can substitute for working technology
Investors will fund without technical verification
constraints_that_moved: Microfluidics advanced (but not to Theranos claims)
Regulatory scrutiny of diagnostic startups increased
lesson: When a technology violates known physics constraints, no amount of capital, charisma, or secrecy can make it real. Constraint surfaces are not suggestions.
